name: War name
description: The name a Mardu warrior earns by proving themselves in a brutal act of honor, usually killing an enemy.

timeline.summary: After the battle, Alesha hears the warriors' deeds and shouts out each new war name.
timeline.quote: she shouted the name for the horde to hear—with never a moment's hesitation.
